name: END_{speed}_WHITE_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R4-SA101 1200 x 450 (1:10 sheet, 2016), square corners, white class 1, no border. END 180 E, baseline 315 (top 135), ink 510 from x 120 (120/510/570). Black annulus outer R223 / inner R178, centre (975, 225) (975/223/2 chain, 178 inner radius); speed numerals 180 D centred in it (135/180/135). Vehicle-mounted frames for mobile work sites only; 25, 40 or 60 -> generated at 25, 40, 60.
